title: Structural characterization of the ACDC domain from ApiAP2 proteins, a potential molecular target against apicomplexan parasites.
authors: Le Berre, Marine; Tubiana, Thibault; Reutersward Waldner, Philippa; Lazar, Noureddine; Li de la Sierra-Gallay, Ines; Santos, Joana M; Llinas, Manuel; Nessler, Sylvie
journal: Acta crystallographica. Section D, Structural biology
one_liner_zh: 该文解析疟原虫ApiAP2蛋白ACDC结构域晶体结构并做小分子对接，虽涉及转录因子相关蛋白-DNA结合域，但核心是结构表征与药物靶向，未聚焦TF-DNA互作机制或AI/物理模拟方法，仅部分相关。
abstract: The apicomplexan AP2 (ApiAP2) proteins are the best characterized family of DNA-binding proteins in Plasmodium spp. malaria parasites. Apart from the AP2 DNA-binding domain, there is little sequence similarity between ApiAP2 proteins. However, a conserved AP2-coincident domain mostly at the C-terminus (ACDC domain) is observed in a subset of the ApiAP2 proteins. The structure and function of this domain remain unknown. We report two crystal structures of ACDC domains derived from distinct Plasmodium ApiAP2 proteins, revealing a conserved, unique, noncanonical, four-helix bundle architecture. We used these structures to perform in silico docking calculations against a library of known antimalarial compounds and identified potential small-molecule ligands that bind in a highly conserved hydrophobic pocket that is present in all apicomplexan ACDC domains. These ligands provide a new molecular basis for the future design of ACDC inhibitors.
abstract_zh: 顶复门AP2（ApiAP2）蛋白是疟原虫属（Plasmodium spp.）疟疾寄生虫中特征最明确的DNA结合蛋白家族。除AP2 DNA结合域外，ApiAP2蛋白之间几乎没有序列相似性。然而，在部分ApiAP2蛋白中观察到主要位于C端的一个保守的AP2伴随结构域（ACDC结构域）。该结构域的结构和功能尚不清楚。我们报告了源自不同疟原虫ApiAP2蛋白的ACDC结构域的两个晶体结构，揭示了一种保守、独特、非经典的四螺旋束架构。我们利用这些结构，针对已知抗疟化合物库进行了计算机模拟对接计算，并识别出潜在的小分子配体，这些配体结合在所有顶复门ACDC结构域中普遍存在的高度保守疏水口袋中。这些配体为未来设计ACDC抑制剂提供了新的分子基础。
